mcq_fix.s: Who among the following preached Syadvada?
mcq_fix.why: odd wording 'is answered as the preacher'; APPSC 2008 key Kundakundacharya

mcq_drop.why: obscure and doubtful trivia (Sheetalanatha birthplace at Bhadrachalam)

pyq_bad.why: garbled: long explanation text merged into stem

patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: 24th/1st/20th Tirthankara, Mahavira's varna (Kshatriya), Santhara = Jains, Syadvada preacher, Syadvadachala Simha title.
Other PSCs repeat Mahavira's life (Kundagrama, Rijupalika, Pavapuri), Parshvanatha-Sammed Shikhar, Chetaka-Lichchhavi, Ajivika = Gosala.
Doctrine items: Triratna belongs to Jainism, Anekantavada/Syadvada are Jain, four forms of existence (Yaksha trap).
AP tilt: early Kakatiyas were Jains (APPSC G2 2011); app adds Vaddamanu, Danavulapadu.
App MCQs mirror PYQs well; mostly statement sets where PYQs are single-fact.
